title: Eurostat Electricity Prices for Household Consumers
description: Semi-annual electricity prices for household consumers across European countries by consumption band, tax component, and currency, Eurostat table nrg_pc_204. Non-geospatial companion table, join key is the country code column geo (NUTS-0), converted to cloud-native Parquet.

data.title: Eurostat Electricity Prices for Household Consumers (Parquet)

table:columns.name: DATAFLOW
table:columns.description: Eurostat dataflow identifier, agency, table code, and version.

table:columns.name: LAST UPDATE
table:columns.description: Timestamp of the last update Eurostat published for this table.

table:columns.name: siec
table:columns.description: Standard International Energy Product Classification code for the energy carrier, here electricity.

table:columns.name: nrg_cons
table:columns.description: Annual household electricity consumption band the price applies to.

table:columns.name: unit
table:columns.description: Unit of measure for the observed value, for example kilowatt hour.

table:columns.name: tax
table:columns.description: Tax and levy component, which taxes the quoted price includes or excludes.

table:columns.name: currency
table:columns.description: Currency of the observed value, euro, national currency, or purchasing power standard.

table:columns.name: geo
table:columns.description: Reporting country as a Eurostat NUTS-0 code. This is the join key to a geometry Collection.

table:columns.name: OBS_VALUE
table:columns.description: The observed electricity price in the stated unit and currency.

table:columns.name: OBS_FLAG
table:columns.description: Observation status flag, for example p provisional, e estimated, d definition differs.
